A record amount of oil was shipped from the Gulf states through the Strait of Hormuz over the past week under the control of US forces in the region, the Al-Hadath television channel said, citing a US administration official. According to the official, the volume of oil transported through the strait over the week totaled 108 million barrels. This is the highest weekly figure since the start of the conflict between the United States and Iran in the Gulf region. The US official also said that Washington is working to prevent the delivery of advanced components to Iran via land routes. In this regard, he expressed skepticism about Tehran's ability to circumvent the blockade imposed by the United States, adding that the United States is trying to prevent Iran from restoring its capabilities.

Nuno Felix RT @Tendar : Major hacking incident: Hackers from Belarus and Ukraine were able to retrieve data from the Russian Federal State Statistics Service "ROSSTAT", the main statistics agency of Russia, headquartered in Moscow. ROSSTAT collects, analyzes, and publishes official data on the country's economy, demographics, environment, and social developments. It also collects death toll data, including those fallen in Russia's war in Ukraine. The Belarusian opposition group "Cyber Partisans" and the pro-Ukrainian group "Silent Crow" were able to retrieve a large volume of data. The news portal "Mediazone" peer-checked the data and confirms high probability in its authenticity. According to reports by Bloomberg, the groups stated on November 1, 2026, that they had infiltrated roughly 25,000 computers within Rosstat's internal infrastructure and extracted around 23 terabytes of data, including millions of civil registry death records. The data showed that a staggering number of 490,000 Russians have been killed by the end of September 2026. And that is not even everything. Russian authorities delay the death confirmation of many soldiers and register them as "missing", well knowing that they are dead. According to Mediazona's data chart, the lag between a Russian soldier being reported missing and his official death confirmation can span two to three years, sometimes even more. Whether this delay derives from lack of information, incompetence or the intent to bypass death payments to relatives is a discussion for another time. Based on this assessment Mediazone believes that the number of dead Russian soldiers is at the moment somewhere at 720,000. Extrapolating from the chart we can also see that the Russian losses are gradually and decisively growing over time. Furthermore, since we know that the wounded-to-kill ratio of Russian soldiers is extremely poor (between 3:1 and 4:1), thanks to absolute disregard of human life on the part of the Russian army and poor medical assistance, we can safely assume that the amount of permanent Russian losses is somewhere between 1.5 and 2 million Russian soldiers. Short: The scale of Russian casualties is not merely severe, but unsustainable - a reality that lends credibility to Ukrainian estimates. Surpassing every conflict Moscow has fought since 1945, the toll is now 50 times higher than Soviet losses during the war in Afghanistan. tweet
